settings.title: Settings

settings.dictationLanguageHint: The language the Mac listens for when you dictate
settings.cavemanHint: Bots answer you in few words, with the same facts. For the messages you send from here; what they write elsewhere stays normal.

guide.mention: Mention another bot in the message
guide.model: Change the model of this conversation
guide.brain: Think it through together, nothing runs

settings.modelsNote: Choose which models appear in the picker, on this Mac and for all bots. The active model and the profile’s model are always offered.
settings.sessionHint: Forgets the credentials saved on this Mac
settings.notificationsTestHint: Sends one now, like a bot that is done
settings.notificationsTestBody: Notifications work: this is how a bot tells you it is done.

notificationsTestResult.shown: Sent. Nothing on screen? Check System Settings > Notifications > HermesBot, and your Focus.
notificationsTestResult.failed: Refused: notifications are off for HermesBot in System Settings > Notifications.
notificationsTestResult.silent: No answer from macOS: this build of the app isn’t signed, so macOS drops its notifications.

settings.notificationsHint: When a bot is done or waits on your answer, unless its chat is in view

vault.removeConfirm: Remove the credentials for {{host}} from the bots machine’s keychain?
vault.note: Credentials the bots use in the shared Chrome. They are stored in the login keychain of the bots machine, visible in Keychain Access. The vault types the password itself: the bot never sees it.
vault.empty: No credentials yet. A bot that needs to sign in will ask you in a window.

serverRequest.checkSite: Make sure this is the right site before continuing.
serverRequest.credentialsNote: Saved in Hermes’s local vault, tied to this site. The bot never sees the password.
serverRequest.unlockBody: {{bot}} needs to use a login saved in {{name}}.
serverRequest.unlockNote: Valid for this session only. The bot never sees this password.
serverRequest.codeHint: {{bot}} is waiting for the code sent to your phone or by email.

errors.request_busy: This request is already in progress.
errors.origin_mismatch: The site shown has changed. Fill-in refused.
errors.origin_not_found: No credentials saved for this site.
errors.vault_unavailable: The bots machine’s keychain is unreachable.
errors.vault_write_failed: The bots machine’s keychain refused the write.
errors.vault_service_unavailable: The bots machine’s vault isn’t responding. From another Mac, ↻ restarts the tunnel.
errors.admin_forbidden: The bots machine’s vault rejects the app: token missing. From another Mac, ↻ fetches it.
errors.user_session_required: Hermes session expired: sign in again to edit the vault.

browserVault.bodySave: Check the site shown in the bots’ Chrome.
browserVault.bodyCode: The code is entered straight into the page, without going through the bot.
browserVault.noteSave: Stored in the bots machine’s keychain, reserved for {{bot}}. Never sent to Hermes, the gateway or the bot.
browserVault.noteCode: No code stays in the chat or the logs.
